title_tag: 缅北电诈“四大家族”覆灭全纪录！被转卖的“猪仔”、晒在屋顶的钱、布满弹孔的墙……—— 美国《华盛顿邮报》外刊讲解第1190天
h1: 缅北电诈“四大家族”覆灭全纪录！被转卖的“猪仔”、晒在屋顶的钱、布满弹孔的墙……
category: 美国《华盛顿邮报》外刊讲解 第1190天

headline.en_html: China cultivated high-rolling crime families before turning on them
headline.zh: 中国曾培植豪横的犯罪家族，而后对其出手整治

notes.en: to develop or foster a relationship, situation, or quality over time
notes.ctx: 培植（指中国曾长期纵容、扶植这些犯罪家族坐大，暗含“养虎为患”之意，标题一开口就带着清算的意味）。
notes.ex1: The regime had cultivated ties with local warlords for decades before finally moving against them. 该政权数十年来一直培植与地方军阀的关系，最终才对其动手。
notes.ex2: He cultivated an image of generosity to win the trust of his neighbors. 他刻意塑造慷慨大方的形象以赢得邻居的信任。

notes.en: to suddenly attack or become hostile toward someone who was previously an ally or friend
notes.zh: 反目成仇，转而攻击（某人）
notes.ctx: 翻脸动手（指中国从昔日的纵容者变成打击者，与犯罪家族彻底反目）。
notes.ex1: The gangster turned on his own brother to save himself. 那名歹徒为求自保，反咬自己的亲兄弟一口。
notes.ex2: Public opinion turned on the celebrity after the scandal broke. 丑闻曝光后，舆论转而对该名人发起攻击。

paragraphs.en_html: For the <mark class="voc">scion</mark> of a crime family linked to human trafficking and <mark class="voc">enslavement</mark>, money laundering and global <mark class="voc">cyberscams</mark>, Wei Qingtao was <mark class="voc">brazenly</mark> public. His Douyin account, the Chinese-language version of TikTok, <mark class="voc">flaunted</mark> the excesses of his life in a remote corner of Myanmar by the border with China: Bentleys and Lamborghinis, rare cigars and private jets. When the 27-year-old partied at the <mark class="voc">multistory</mark> glass-walled nightclub he owned in a region called Kokang, he’d throw crisp Chinese yuan bills into the crowd.
paragraphs.zh: 魏清涛出身于一个与人口贩卖、奴役、洗钱及全球网络诈骗有关的犯罪家族，但他却毫不遮掩、招摇过市。他的抖音账号——即TikTok的中文版——大肆炫耀其在缅甸与中国边境交界偏远一角奢靡无度的生活：宾利、兰博基尼、稀有雪茄和私人飞机。这位27岁的年轻人若在他位于果敢地区、拥有多层玻璃幕墙的夜店里开派对，便会将一沓沓崭新的百元人民币大钞撒向人群。

notes.en: a descendant or heir of a notable or wealthy family
notes.ctx: 名门之后（指犯罪家族的后辈魏清涛，词本身带贵气，用在这里全是讽刺）。
notes.ex1: The scion of a banking dynasty stunned everyone by becoming a street artist. 这位银行世家的子弟成了街头艺术家，令所有人大跌眼镜。
notes.ex2: As the scion of a political family, she was expected to enter public service. 作为政治家族的后代，人们期望她从政。

notes.en: the act of forcing someone into slavery; the state of being completely controlled by another
notes.ctx: 奴役（指犯罪集团强迫被贩卖者无偿劳动、剥夺人身自由）。
notes.ex1: The museum documents the enslavement of millions of people across the Atlantic. 这座博物馆记录了大西洋彼岸数百万人被奴役的历史。
notes.ex2: Debt bondage is a modern form of enslavement that persists in many regions. 债务奴役是一种现代形式的奴役，在许多地区依然存在。

notes.en: a fraudulent scheme carried out over the internet, typically to steal money or personal information
notes.ctx: 网络诈骗（指犯罪集团借互联网对中国民众实施的电信诈骗）。
notes.ex1: Authorities warned that cyberscams targeting the elderly have risen sharply. 当局警告称，针对老年人的网络诈骗急剧上升。
notes.ex2: He lost his life savings to a cyberscam that promised huge investment returns. 他因一个承诺高额投资回报的网络骗局而损失了毕生积蓄。

notes.en: in an obvious, shameless, and bold manner, without attempting to hide one's actions
notes.zh: 厚颜无耻地，明目张胆地
notes.ctx: 明目张胆地（魏清涛毫不遮掩地炫富，与其犯罪背景形成强烈反差）。
notes.ex1: The official brazenly demanded bribes in front of witnesses. 那名官员在众目睽睽之下公然索贿。
notes.ex2: She brazenly lied to the court, knowing the evidence would expose her. 她明知证据会揭穿自己，却仍厚颜无耻地在法庭上撒谎。

notes.en: to display something ostentatiously, especially wealth or possessions, in order to attract attention or envy
notes.ctx: 炫耀（指他在抖音上大晒豪车、雪茄、私人飞机等奢靡生活）。
notes.ex1: He flaunted his new Rolex at every opportunity, annoying his colleagues. 他一有机会就炫耀新买的劳力士，惹得同事很反感。
notes.ex2: The company flaunted its environmental record, though its factories were among the worst polluters. 该公司大肆标榜自己的环保成绩，尽管其工厂是污染最严重的企业之一。

notes.en: having several floors or levels
notes.ctx: 多层的（指魏清涛那栋多层玻璃幕墙夜店，越写越显出气派与张扬）。
notes.ex1: They moved into a multistory apartment building near the city center. 他们搬进了市中心附近的一栋多层公寓楼。
notes.ex2: The multistory parking garage was nearly empty at midnight. 午夜时分，那座多层停车楼几乎空无一人。

paragraphs.en_html: In November, the good times <mark class="voc">rolled to a stop</mark>. Wei’s social media presence <mark class="voc">vanished</mark>. He soon appeared in a different kind of video: reading a scripted <mark class="voc">confession</mark> while in Chinese <mark class="voc">custody</mark>. “The money we make from cyberscams comes from the pensions of everyday Chinese people,” Wei said. “This time, the Chinese government has made up its mind. … We must not <mark class="voc">cling to</mark> any illusions.” Within weeks, his uncle was <mark class="voc">in cuffs</mark> on a plane to China, <mark class="voc">flanked by</mark> dozens of police officers.
paragraphs.zh: 到了11月，这段纸醉金迷的好日子戛然而止。魏清涛在社交媒体上的身影消失无踪。不久后，他出现在另一类视频中：在中国羁押之下，照本宣读一份认罪供词。“我们搞网络诈骗赚的钱，都是中国老百姓的养老钱，”魏清涛说。“这次中国政府下定决心……我们绝不能抱有任何幻想。”数周之内，他的叔叔便戴着手铐、在数十名警察押解下被带上飞往中国的飞机。

notes.en: to gradually slow down and come to a halt, especially of a vehicle or a process
notes.ctx: 戛然而止（车轮慢慢停住，比喻魏清涛的奢靡好日子一点点驶到终点）。
notes.ex1: The train rolled to a stop at the abandoned station. 火车在废弃的车站缓缓停下。
notes.ex2: After months of speculation, the merger talks finally rolled to a stop. 经过数月的猜测，合并谈判终于画上句号。

notes.en: to disappear suddenly and completely, often in a mysterious way
notes.ctx: 消失（社交媒体账号突然销声匿迹，暗示人已经被控制）。
notes.ex1: The suspect vanished without a trace shortly after the robbery. 抢劫案发生后不久，嫌疑人便消失得无影无踪。
notes.ex2: Her smile vanished the moment she heard the news. 她一听到那个消息，笑容便瞬间消失。

notes.en: a formal statement admitting guilt, especially to a crime
notes.ctx: 认罪供词（指魏清涛在羁押中照本宣读的那份自白）。
notes.ex1: The police obtained a signed confession from the suspect. 警方取得了嫌疑人签字的认罪供词。
notes.ex2: His confession in court shocked the victims' families. 他在法庭上的认罪令受害者家属震惊。

notes.en: the state of being kept in prison or under guard by the police; legal guardianship
notes.ctx: 羁押（指魏清涛被中国警方拘押的状态，注意是“中国”羁押，不是缅甸）。
notes.ex1: The suspect was taken into custody immediately after the hearing. 听证会结束后，嫌疑人立即被羁押。
notes.ex2: She was awarded custody of her two children after the divorce. 离婚后，她获得了两个孩子的监护权。

notes.en: to refuse to give up an idea, belief, or hope, even when it is no longer reasonable
notes.ctx: 抱有任何幻想（供词里劝同伙别再心存侥幸、别再死抱不放）。
notes.ex1: He still clings to the belief that she will come back one day. 他仍执迷于她终有一天会回来的念头。
notes.ex2: Investors who clung to the falling stock lost everything. 那些死守下跌股票的投资者血本无归。

notes.en: wearing handcuffs; under arrest
notes.ctx: 戴着手铐（指魏清涛的叔叔被押上飞往中国的飞机）。
notes.ex1: The suspect was led out of the courtroom in cuffs. 嫌疑人戴着手铐被带出法庭。
notes.ex2: He ended up in cuffs after a drunken brawl. 他因酒后斗殴最终被铐走。

notes.en: to be positioned at the sides of someone or something; to be accompanied on both sides
notes.ctx: 两侧由……押解（数十名警察左右夹着走，一个被动句把场面写足了）。
notes.ex1: The president entered the hall, flanked by security guards. 总统在安保人员的簇拥下进入大厅。
notes.ex2: The painting is flanked by two smaller portraits. 那幅画的两侧各挂着一幅较小的肖像。

paragraphs.en_html: The <mark class="voc">clans</mark> controlled every aspect of life in Kokang, becoming lawmakers, <mark class="voc">militia</mark> heads, local administrators and powerful business executives. But at the heart of the Kokang empire were <mark class="voc">casinos</mark>, underground banking and money laundering, according to U.N. officials and U.S. diplomatic <mark class="voc">cables</mark> released by WikiLeaks. Newly built mega-casinos in the Kokang capital, Laukkaing, opened 24 hours a day.
paragraphs.zh: 这些家族曾掌控果敢地区生活的方方面面，摇身变为议员、民兵首领、地方行政官员和权势熏天的商界高管。但据联合国官员及维基解密公布的美国外交电报显示，果敢帝国的核心是赌场、地下钱庄和洗钱。果敢首府老街新建的大型赌场，全天24小时营业。

notes.en: a large group of related families, especially one that is powerful and influential
notes.ctx: 家族（指把持果敢的几大犯罪家族，clan 比 family 更强调宗族与抱团）。
notes.ex1: The two clans had feuded over land for generations. 两大家族为土地争斗了几代人。
notes.ex2: She rose to prominence within her clan through sheer determination. 她凭着一股韧劲在家族中崭露头角。

notes.en: a military force made up of ordinary citizens rather than professional soldiers, often operating locally
notes.ctx: 民兵（家族头目兼任民兵首领，手里握着枪杆子，这才是他们敢横的底气）。
notes.ex1: The village formed a militia to defend itself against bandits. 村民组建民兵以抵御匪徒。
notes.ex2: The militia controlled the roads leading into the region. 民兵控制了通往该地区的道路。

notes.en: a building or room where people play gambling games for money
notes.ctx: 赌场（果敢帝国的核心产业之一，也是洗钱与诈骗的入口）。
notes.ex1: He lost a fortune at the casino in a single night. 他一夜之间在赌场输掉了一大笔钱。
notes.ex2: The city legalized casinos to boost tourism revenue. 该市将赌场合法化以增加旅游收入。

notes.en: a confidential message or document sent between government officials or diplomats
notes.ctx: 外交电报（维基解密公布的美国外交电报，为这篇调查提供了硬证据）。
notes.ex1: The leaked cables revealed the ambassador's private views on the conflict. 泄露的电报揭示了这位大使对冲突的私下看法。
notes.ex2: Diplomatic cables from that period offer valuable insight into the negotiations. 那个时期的外交电文为谈判提供了宝贵的洞见。

paragraphs.en_html: Behind the vast casino floors, a more <mark class="voc">sinister</mark> industry started to grow. Chinese court documents show that from at least 2018 “criminal <mark class="voc">syndicates</mark>” were <mark class="voc">smuggling</mark> people into the <mark class="voc">Crouching</mark> Tiger Villa, a <mark class="voc">banquet</mark> hall and hotel, and forcing them to work as scammers. Border closures that followed the outbreak of the coronavirus pandemic shut off the cash flow to the casinos, accelerating a shift to this new scam economy.
paragraphs.zh: 在广阔的赌场大厅背后，一个更为阴暗的产业开始滋生。中国法院文件显示，至少从2018年起，“犯罪集团”便开始向“卧虎山庄”——一处兼作宴会厅和酒店的场所——偷运人口，强迫他们从事诈骗工作。新冠疫情暴发后边境关闭，切断了赌场的现金流，加速了向这一新型诈骗经济的转型。

notes.en: suggesting evil or harm; seeming threatening or ominous
notes.ctx: 更为阴暗的（赌场背后长出来的诈骗产业，比赌博更邪、更狠）。
notes.ex1: There was something sinister about the abandoned house at the end of the street. 街道尽头那栋废弃的房子透着一种不祥的气息。
notes.ex2: The investigation uncovered a sinister plot to silence the whistleblowers. 调查揭露了一个封杀举报人的邪恶阴谋。

notes.en: a group of people or organizations combined to carry out a criminal or business enterprise
notes.ctx: 犯罪集团（有组织地干偷渡、诈骗的团伙，比 gang 更强调企业化运作）。
notes.ex1: An international crime syndicate was behind the art theft. 这起艺术品盗窃案背后是一个国际犯罪集团。
notes.ex2: The syndicate laundered money through a chain of shell companies. 该集团通过一系列空壳公司洗钱。

notes.en: to move people or goods illegally and secretly across borders
notes.ctx: 偷运（把人当货一样非法运进园区，一词点破“贩卖”的性质）。
notes.ex1: They were caught trying to smuggle rare animals across the border. 他们试图将珍稀动物偷运过境时被抓获。
notes.ex2: Thousands of migrants are smuggled into the country each year. 每年有数千名移民被偷运入境。

notes.en: to bend one's knees and lower the body close to the ground, often to hide or prepare to spring
notes.ctx: 蹲伏（“Crouching Tiger Villa”即“卧虎山庄”，取“卧虎”之意：伏着不动，伺机噬人）。
notes.ex1: The cat crouched low, ready to pounce on the bird. 猫低低蹲伏，准备扑向那只鸟。
notes.ex2: He crouched behind the wall to avoid being seen. 他蹲伏在墙后以免被发现。

notes.en: a large formal meal for many people, often held to celebrate a special occasion
notes.ctx: 宴会厅（山庄兼作宴会厅与酒店，门面越体面，里面越不堪）。
notes.ex1: The charity banquet raised over a million dollars. 这场慈善宴会筹集了逾百万美元。
notes.ex2: A lavish banquet was held in honor of the visiting delegation. 为欢迎来访代表团举行了盛大的宴会。

paragraphs.en_html: Workers, mostly Chinese nationals or <mark class="voc">ethnic Chinese</mark>, were bought, sold and traded; and then beaten, <mark class="voc">tortured</mark> or killed when they didn’t reach financial targets or tried to escape, according to firsthand accounts. Many of the compounds for running scam operations were hosted in the same hotels and casino complexes long established by the clans. Others were purpose-built, but had telltale signs like barred windows, high walls and even Myanmar military <mark class="voc">snipers</mark> on the rooftops, witnesses said.
paragraphs.zh: 第一手证词，这些工人——大多是中国公民或华裔——被买卖和交易；一旦未能达到财务指标或试图逃跑，便会遭到殴打、酷刑甚至杀害。许多用于运营诈骗活动的园区，就设在各家族早已建起的酒店和赌场综合体内。目击者称，另有一些则是专门建造的，但带有明显的标志，如铁栅窗户、高墙，甚至屋顶上还有缅甸军方狙击手。

notes.en: people of Chinese descent living outside China, or belonging to the Chinese ethnic group
notes.ctx: 华裔（被卖进园区的人多是中国公民或华裔，这一句也解释了北京为何必须出手）。
notes.ex1: Ethnic Chinese communities have thrived in Southeast Asia for centuries. 华人社区数百年来在东南亚蓬勃发展。
notes.ex2: Many ethnic Chinese in the region speak both Mandarin and the local language. 该地区许多华裔既会说普通话，也会说当地语言。

notes.en: to inflict severe physical or mental pain on someone, especially to punish or force a confession
notes.ctx: 施以酷刑（园区对付业绩不达标或想逃跑的人的常规手段）。
notes.ex1: The prisoners were tortured for information they did not have. 囚犯们因被逼问他们根本不知道的情报而遭受酷刑。
notes.ex2: He was tortured by guilt for years after the accident. 事故发生后，他多年来备受愧疚的折磨。

notes.en: a person who shoots at people from a hidden position, especially from a distance
notes.ctx: 狙击手（缅甸军方狙击手守在园区屋顶，戒备森严到毫无人性）。
notes.ex1: The sniper waited patiently on the rooftop for his target to appear. 狙击手在屋顶耐心等待目标出现。
notes.ex2: Peacekeepers were pinned down by sniper fire for hours. 维和人员被狙击手的火力压制了数小时。
